card.name: Statements that no adjustment is needed
card.fires_on: Negation words such as no, not, or require, and the words right after them, in sentences saying a patient group needs no change or no treatment. Common in renal or hepatic impairment dosing sections.

modes.label: No adjustment needed

modes.example: Adult patients with mild hepatic impairment (Child-Pugh score 5 to 6) do<< not>> need a dosage adjustment.
